verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a diff viewer, change review, or running checks or tests before merging in ZCode. The closest item is a claim that Goals plan, execute and verify multi-step work, which is a general agent-workflow claim and not diff inspection or pre-merge checks. A community comment about monitoring file edits in OpenCode is about another product and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging
